ARUNACHAL PRADESH

No,PSC-R(B)/08/20L9 Dated ltanagar, the 1't June,2020.
NOTIFICATION
ln continuation of Commission's advertisement No.PSC-R(B\/OB|2O2O Dated 13th
March,2020, this is to inform to all the aspiring candidates for the post of Junior
Engineer(C) under the Department of Rural Works that online submission of application for
the posts of JE(C) is re-opened w.e.f. 03.06.2020 to O3.O7.,2020 till 4 P.M.
(www.appsc.online.inl after which the link will be disabled. The online submission of
application is extended for those aspiring candidates who could not submit their application
online due to nation-wide lockdown for CoViD-19 pandemic.
